items.title: Flatness of the lifted morphism in a morphism of thickenings of algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a morphism of thickenings of algebraic spaces over a finite order thickening of the bases, with the total source flat over its base and the restricted morphism flat, the lemma proves that the lifted morphism is flat and that the total target is flat over its base at the image points. The proof chooses a surjective etale chart by schemes, transports the hypotheses to the chart, applies the schemes-side flatness result there, and then descends flatness back through the chart. The descent of flatness through the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 4043-4064.
